title: Add context continuity checks to startup planning
description: Operator-authorized follow-up to TASK-271. Make every AI Command Center Lab startup orientation validate the continuity ledger, run current-agent context advice, and include checkpoint/rotation state in the single startup status/resume-plan message. Update durable startup policy, launcher prompt templates, and focused tests without changing the verified rotation protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Both installed lab launcher prompts require startup orientation to run context_rotation.py validate and advise for the exact current hcom identity before routing work.
The one startup hcom message to bigboss includes continuity validation state and the current checkpoint/rotation recommendation alongside the resume plan or priorities request.
Startup documentation and MAP_System/AGENTS.md state the same ordering and safe behavior: startup checks advise/validate only and never supersede or clear a session automatically.
Focused tests parse both launcher templates and fail if either startup contract omits validate, advise, continuity ledger, or plan-reporting language.
